newsitem.title: USA: Ethical patch starts Phase III trials.
newsitem.headline: Ethical patch starts Phase III trials.

text.p: Ethical Holdings Plc said it has started Phase III clinical trials in the United States for its combination estrogen-progestogen transdermal patch for use in Hormone Replacement Therapy (HRT).
The patch has been licensed for future marketing in the United States and selected international markets to G.D. Searle & Co, the pharmaceutical subsidiary of Monsanto Co.
Ethical said it opened an Investigational New Drug (IND) for this patch last month and has entered directly into Phase III clinical studies in the United States.

This U.S. development strategy is made possible by the existence of Ethical's database of preclinical and clinical data supporting the safety and efficacy of its products which have undergone advanced clinical programs in Europe, the company said.
Phase III clinical trials for this HRT combination patch are ongoing in the UK, Ethical said.
The HRT combination transdermal patch is being developed for use in sequential HRT therapy, the company said.
The patch incorporates Ethical's patented Jenderm advanced generation transdermal technology and is intended for use in treating the vasomotor symptoms of menopause, the company said.
